boundary: Agent-mediated effects routed through the Node backend and runtime launch paths

effectors.limitation: Bound Node mission processes only; a legacy unbound mission has no sealed body action.
Bound Node dispatch only; later worker execution has its own process action.

effectors.predictionHook: bodyActionReceiptService.predict when a sealed actor is supplied
effectors.limitation: External direct calls without a sealed actor remain unattributed.

The Solar direct writer emits a path and content hash through its runtime IPC; matching final bytes are listed as directWrites. Other eligible changes remain temporally correlated, including changes made by the local Codex runtime or concurrent writers. Ignored paths are unobserved.

effectors.predictionHook: mcpActorCapability.begin for a bearer capability issued by the sealed Node supervisor
effectors.limitation: Authenticated Rust tools/call requires a sealed mission capability and the shared SQLite database path from the Node control plane. Standalone stdio calls remain external/unattributed; authenticated omega/execute is refused.

limitation: Inventory is explicit for known agent-mediated action channels; uncovered and out-of-band effectors are not treated as validated.
